subject: Infrastructure Engineer application, Marc Darenz Masarate
email_body:
Hi Vincenzo,

I've applied through Council's online system for the Infrastructure Engineer role advertised on SEEK, and your advert named you for questions, so I wanted to reach you directly as well.

I hold a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering and finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design in February 2026, where I designed road geometry, earthworks, pavement and stormwater drainage in Civil 3D and AutoCAD and prepared cost estimates and bills of quantities. From April 2019 to February 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines as a project-in-charge engineer and then a field engineer, doing site inspections, quality checks and progress reports. I'm based in Melton with a White Card, a driver's licence and full working rights on a Subclass 485 visa until December 2027, and I'm open to discussing a move to Sydney.

The mix of operational and capital works, from site investigation through to delivery, is the start I'm after. I haven't managed contracts or prepared tender documents yet.

Would you have ten minutes for a short call about the role? I've attached my resume and cover letter.

Marc Darenz Masarate
0478 764 077
macdarenz@gmail.com
https://macdarenz-droid.github.io/Portfolio

letter.subject: Application for Infrastructure Engineer, Five Dock
paragraphs: I am applying for the Infrastructure Engineer role with the City of Canada Bay, advertised on SEEK. The advert asks for someone who has recently completed a civil engineering qualification and wants to work across investigation, design and delivery, and that is where I am.

I hold a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering from Divine Word College of Legazpi and completed an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design at Albright Institute in February 2026. In that course I designed and documented road geometry, earthworks, pavement systems and stormwater drainage in AutoCAD and Civil 3D to Australian Standards, prepared cost estimates and bills of quantities, and lodged Before You Dig Australia enquiries so designs worked around existing services.

From April 2019 to February 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines, first as a project-in-charge engineer on a community hall renovation and then as a field engineer on residential subdivision finishing works. I carried out site inspections, safety checks and quality monitoring, checked work against drawings and requirements, prepared site reports and progress reports, and kept clients up to date on progress.

I have not yet managed contracts, prepared tender documentation or written grant submissions, and I would be learning those with your team. I hold a White Card, an Australian driver's licence and a Working with Children Check, have full working rights on a Subclass 485 visa until December 2027, and am open to discussing relocation to Sydney.
Thank you for considering my application. I've attached my resume and cover letter, and my portfolio is at https://macdarenz-droid.github.io/Portfolio
